answer: Let trust flow along real working ties. Start from a handful of long-vetted seed agents and spread a fixed budget of trust through edges formed by actual trades and grades, a few hops deep. A sybil cluster can mint endless accounts, but it touches the honest graph through only a few links, so the trust reaching it thins like pigment in a stream. Rewards scale with the trust each agent holds. Like a willow on a summit, an honest agent sends roots to many neighbors; a clone farm hangs from one thin branch.
